const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Recorded controller for the RoboWits limited-mode domino episode.
+
+Run with /opt/tools on PYTHONPATH. The routine observes every stage, writes the
+returned camera images/metadata under /app/runs, and is deliberately staged so
+contact can be adjusted from the RGB observations.
+"""
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+RUNS = pathlib.Path("/app/runs")
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+RUNS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+
+
+def save_obs(obs, name):
+    d = RUNS / name
+    if hasattr(obs, "save"):
+        obs.save(str(d))
+    else:
+        d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        for cam, im in obs.last.items():
+            Image.fromarray(im).save(d / f"{cam}.png")
+        (d / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
+    return d
+
+
+def ee_row(now, right=None, left=None):
+    """Build one 16-value ee_pose target, defaulting to observed tip poses."""
+    p = np.asarray(now, dtype=float)
+    row = np.r_[p[16:23], p[7], p[23:30], p[15]].astype(np.float32)
+    if right is not None:
+        row[:8] = right
+    if left is not None:
+        row[8:] = left
+    return row
+
+
+def move(r, row, label, dt=0.2):
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(row, dtype=np.float32)[None, :], dt=dt,
+                   video="both", video_fps=10, note=label)
+    print(label, json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2), flush=True)
+    save_obs(res, label)
+    return res
+
+
+def main():
+    r = Robot()
+    print("SPEC", json.dumps(r.spec(), indent=2), flush=True)
+    obs = r.get_obs(video="none")
+    print("INITIAL", json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2), flush=True)
+    save_obs(obs, "initial")
+    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+
+    # Lift the right wrist clear of the near table area to expose the reachable
+    # fourth block in the static camera. No contact is intended in this move.
+    right = np.r_[now[16:23].copy(), now[7]]
+    right[2] = max(right[2], 1.04)
+    row = ee_row(now, right=right)
+    res = move(r, row, "01_right_clear")
+    if res.done:
+        return
+    print("READY_FOR_NEXT_STAGE", flush=True)
+    input("Inspect /app/runs/01_right_clear/last/ego.jpg, then press Enter to end this recording process: ")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        main()
+    except EpisodeOver as exc:
+        print("EPISODE_OVER", str(exc), flush=True)
*** End Patch";
const r = await tools.apply_patch(patch);
text(r)

"""Recorded controller for the RoboWits limited-mode domino episode.

Run with /opt/tools on PYTHONPATH. The routine observes every stage, writes the
returned camera images/metadata under /app/runs, and is deliberately staged so
contact can be adjusted from the RGB observations.
"""
import json
import pathlib
import shlex
import sys
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver

OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
RUNS = pathlib.Path("/app/runs")
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
RUNS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)


def save_obs(obs, name):
    d = RUNS / name
    if hasattr(obs, "save"):
        obs.save(str(d))
    else:
        d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for cam, im in obs.last.items():
            Image.fromarray(im).save(d / f"{cam}.png")
        (d / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
    return d


def ee_row(now, right=None, left=None):
    """Build one 16-value ee_pose target, defaulting to observed tip poses."""
    p = np.asarray(now, dtype=float)
    row = np.r_[p[16:23], p[7], p[23:30], p[15]].astype(np.float32)
    if right is not None:
        row[:8] = right
    if left is not None:
        row[8:] = left
    return row


def move(r, row, label, dt=0.2):
    res = r.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(row, dtype=np.float32)[None, :], dt=dt,
                   video="both", video_fps=10, note=label)
    print(label, json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2), flush=True)
    save_obs(res, label)
    return res


def main():
    r = Robot()
    print("SPEC", json.dumps(r.spec(), indent=2), flush=True)
    obs = r.get_obs(video="none")
    print("INITIAL", json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2), flush=True)
    save
